# ReviewNodeParams

`schemas/records/review-node-params.json`

The params of a review node: its subject and roster (docs/design/m0/13 "The reviewer roster is part of a review's identity"), which records/node selects for kind review. The roster is in the params digest, so it is in the computation key: a result of one roster never satisfies another roster's key, and equivalence never reuses a review across rosters. internal/graph records a review only through RecordReview and claims it only through ClaimReview, which both check each member's family against the executor registry and refuse an executor of unknown family; it also refuses a roster not sorted by executor or naming an executor twice.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subject` | yes | [Name](records-receipt.md#name) | What the review is of, named as the review requirement names it (records/review-requirement). A review that declares a requirement input is claimed only on a requirement of this subject. |
| `roster` | yes | array of [RosterMember](#rostermember) (minItems `1`) | The reviewers, sorted by executor id. Placement leases each member on exactly its executor (05). |

No other fields are allowed.

## Definitions

### RosterMember

One reviewer: the executor it is pinned to and that executor's model family, derived from the controller's executor registry and never asserted by a caller (06 rule 3). The family is never unknown.

#### Fields of RosterMember

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `executor` | yes | [ExecutorID](common-defs.md#executorid) |  |
| `family` | yes | [Name](records-receipt.md#name) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
